E4Plus1.uk.description: Paris: The family head to Paris so that Jay can accept a lifetime achievement award for his work in the closet industry. But his old nemesis, Earl Chambers, haunts him. (S11 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Baby Steps: Cam and Mitch debate the pros and cons of adopting another baby after receiving an unexpected call from the agency. And Claire lands an interview for her dream job. (S11 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: I'm Going to Miss This: When Mitchell struggles to let go of his old life, Gloria helps him to say goodbye. And Haley, Luke and Alex decide to throw a party at the Dunphy house. (S11 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Finale (Part 1/2): Mitchell and Cam settle on their new normal, and Phil and Claire decide that one of the kids needs to move out so they can take control of the house again. (S11 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brother from Another Series: Sideshow Bob (guest star Kelsey Grammer) is once again released from prison, into the care of his respectable brother Cecil (David Hyde Pierce). (S8 Ep16/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Sister, My Sitter: Lisa starts a new career as a babysitter. All is going well, until Marge and Homer employ her to look after Bart and Maggie... (S8 Ep17/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer vs the Eighteenth Amendment: When alcohol is banned in Springfield, Moe's Tavern becomes a speakeasy and Homer re-invents himself as the Beer Baron. (S8 Ep18/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Grade School Confidential: Principal Skinner and Mrs Krabappel embark on a torrid affair but have to bribe Bart to keep the whole thing a secret. (S8 Ep19/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fraudcast News: When Mr Burns is reported dead, all the media outlets say what they really think of him. But the announcement is premature, and Mr Burns takes revenge... (S15 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wreck of the Relationship: Homer and Bart take part in a father-son therapy exercise on a ship. While they're away, Marge gets involved in Homer's fantasy football league. (S26 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Life aboard the St David isn't getting any easier. The chef's misplaced his sea legs, and the deck team is in disarray thanks to some dodgy leadership. (S12 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Notting Hill
E4Plus1.uk.description: (1999) Hugh Grant and Julia Roberts star in the BAFTA-winning comedy romance about a bookshop owner who manages to get a glamorous movie star to go out with him. With Rhys Ifans.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Open House: The Great Sex...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Experiment: Committed couples explore whether open relationships can strengthen their bonds. Can Jonny and Sarah overcome their nerves? And will Tanith and Paul partake? (S3 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pansexual Sarah can't wait to road test her new body on her first date as a woman. Plumber Jamie's love life has gone down the U-bend, so he's all cisterns go to find a partner. (S11 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Life aboard the St David isn't getting any easier. The chef's misplaced his sea legs, and the deck team is in disarray thanks to some dodgy leadership. (S12 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wrong Delivery: When Janine gets a look at the new charter school down the street, she becomes determined to make Abbott just as good. Gregory avoids Barbara. (S2 Ep2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Edward 'Eddie the Eagle' Edwards: Barry seeks fresh inspiration when he loses his standing as a champion athlete at school. Sales at Murray's shop nosedive. (S3 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Full Boyle: Boyle's new romance increases his self-confidence, Diaz and Santiago can't take a costumed crime-fighter seriously, and Holt faces a leadership challenge. (S1 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Apartment: Peralta is in danger of losing his flat but has no money to buy his own place, so Gina tries to help him find a new home. The officers do self-evaluations. (S1 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tactical Village: The officers attend mandatory training exercises where all regional precincts compete. Captain Holt becomes addicted to a game on his phone. (S1 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fancy Brudgom: Boyle asks Peralta to be his best man. Jeffords, Santiago and Gina start a new diet but struggle to stick to it. Holt helps Diaz to make a sincere apology. (S1 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Unsolvable: Peralta and Jeffords tackle a cold case that everyone thinks is unsolvable, while Santiago plans a romantic weekend away with her new boyfriend Teddy. (S1 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Charges and Specs: Peralta suspects a civic leader of money laundering, but the police commissioner shuts down his investigation. Vivian ends her relationship with Boyle. (S1 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great Australian Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Biscuit Week: Our bakers risk it for the biscuit as they build planes, trains and automobiles from - you guessed it - biscuit! But it's a taxi home for two... (S7 Ep4/10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring the effects of dental anaesthetics.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: Andy plans an authentic Ukrainian wedding... in Ukraine. But fussy bride-to-be Anna and her hard-to-please mum are banking on a very British bash.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Paw Patrol: The Movie
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2021) Family animation. The plucky pups head to the city to foil dastardly Mayor Humdinger's latest plot. But can Chase overcome his fear of the big smoke and be the hero everyone needs?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Roosevelt Inn: Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the owner of the Roosevelt Inn in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, is busy cracking jokes and playing dress up. Can Gordon help? (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: M'Dears Bakery and Bistro: In LA, Gordon visits M'Dears Bakery and Bistro, which specialises in Southern cuisine with a Californian twist, to revamp the dining area and the menu. (S2 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Social: Gordon Ramsay revamps the menu and redecorates at Social, a restaurant in affluent Costa Mesa in California. What will the customers think of the improvements? (S2 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Shanty on 19th: Gordon transforms Shanty on 19th, an iconic restaurant in the West End theatre district of Allentown in Pennsylvania, into a bright and airy contemporary bistro. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Vasi's Restaurant and Bar: Gordon visits a family-owned eatery in Waterbury, Connecticut, to remodel the dated interior into an inviting Mediterranean seaside taverna. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pulpit Friction: A trendy new reverend recruits Homer as a deacon. Dry cleaners accidentally swap Marge's wedding dress for one of Krusty's clown costumes. (S24 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Fabulous Faker Boy: Bart doesn't want to go to piano lessons, until he meets his beautiful teacher... Homer loses the last two hairs on his head. (S24 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Saga of Carl: Homer, Moe, Lenny and Carl win the lottery, but Carl runs off to Iceland with the winnings. (S24 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2009) Animated comedy with Bill Hader. When Flint Lockwood invents a machine that turns water into food, he becomes the hero of Swallow Falls. But has he bitten off more than he can chew?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangers on a Train: While she's browsing for wedding anniversary cakes, Marge stumbles across a website for married people who want to have affairs. (S24 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wreck of the Relationship: Homer and Bart take part in a father-son therapy exercise on a ship. While they're away, Marge gets involved in Homer's fantasy football league. (S26 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Supercruising: Life at Sea
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the North Africa and Europe voyage, the chefs prepare a fine-dining experience with a difference, while the Caribbean cruisers enjoy tranquil bamboo rafting in the scorching heat. (Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: From This Morning to 8 Days: To the Moon and Back, what do Loyle Carner, Shaun Ryder, Bez, Chris Kamara, Olly Alexander, Oti Mabuse and other famous faces think of our top telly? (S1 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time it's Race Across the World, Married at First Sight Australia, The Apprentice, Last One Laughing, Secrets of the Bees, Just One Thing and Celebrity Ex on the Beach. (S27 Ep9)
